card.summary: No fee. 'Teldrive requires PostgreSQL and a Telegram account.' The bytes go into the account's own Telegram channels; the software is MIT-licensed.

free_tier.stated: No fee. 'Teldrive requires PostgreSQL and a Telegram account.' The bytes go into the account's own Telegram channels; the software is MIT-licensed.
free_tier.notes: 'unlimited' is Telegram's own claim about the account, not Teldrive's about itself

per_object_cap.stated: Inherits Telegram's per-object ceiling: 2 GB on a free account, 4 GB with Premium.
per_object_cap.notes: Teldrive states no cap of its own

retention.stated: As long as the Telegram account and the channel survive. The project warns: 'Accounts and stored files can become unavailable; keep independent backups.'

egress.terms: Telegram's own terms; downloads come from Telegram's media DCs, at the speed a free account is allowed.

record.interface_detail: 'Telegram-backed file storage with a web interface, an HTTP API, and rclone integration.' Login is by Telegram account, and channels are synced from the UI.
record.tooling: Linux/Windows binaries, Nix, Docker or Podman; a maintained rclone fork (tgdrive/rclone) supplies the backend. PostgreSQL is mandatory.
record.chaining: Turns a set of Telegram channels into one mounted filesystem, which is the only way to make the per-object cap stop being the unit of work: the user sees files, the backend shards them.

limits.value: 2 GB free / 4 GB Premium, governed by Telegram
Telegram flood control applies to the account Teldrive drives

record.binding_note: Teldrive cannot change the object ceiling; it only hides it. At 1 TiB/month the 2 GB cap still splits every large object, and the account's upload flood limits (FLOOD_PREMIUM_WAIT_X on a non-Premium account) shape the rate.

identity_cost.detail: A Telegram account plus api_id/api_hash, and a PostgreSQL instance that must be run. This is software, not a hosted service.

record.reliability_note: The project ships its own warning: 'Follow Telegram's terms and API limits. Accounts and stored files can become unavailable; keep independent backups.' A ban takes the whole drive with it.
record.confidence_note: Requirements and the data-safety sentence are from the repository read. No instance was deployed, so the effective throughput is unmeasured.

evidence.proved: 'Teldrive requires PostgreSQL and a Telegram account.' and 'Telegram-backed file storage with a web interface, an HTTP API, and rclone integration.'
'Follow Telegram's terms and API limits. Accounts and stored files can become unavailable; keep independent backups.'
'organize your Telegram files and unlock their full potential as cloud storage' with an rclone mount and optional encryption

record.notes: This is software that must be run locally, unlike every bot among debrid providers. It is included because it is the only maintained path that presents Telegram as a filesystem, and because the free compute tier can host it; abandon if the PostgreSQL requirement or the rclone fork stops being maintained.
